title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government replies to the Committee’s 2020 report by saying it will set up clear public standards for AI, focusing on safety, transparency and accountability. It plans to work with industry, experts and the public to create guidelines and regulations that keep AI use responsible and protect citizens.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual is developing guidelines to ensure that artificial intelligence is used fairly, transparently, and securely in the qualifications sector. The policy will set standards for AI integration in exams, provide oversight mechanisms, and involve key education and industry stakeholders to safeguard assessment integrity.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: The report examines how copyright‑protected works are used to train AI systems and evaluates the legal and economic impacts of such use. It aims to provide guidance on balancing creators' rights with innovation in AI development.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The government has issued a formal reply to the House of Lords Select Committee’s report on artificial intelligence, acknowledging the committee’s concerns about AI’s rapid growth in the UK. It outlines a set of planned measures aimed at strengthening regulation, boosting investment, and ensuring AI is developed safely and responsibly.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the purpose, scope, and responsibilities of a committee tasked with reviewing how artificial intelligence impacts public standards. It also includes a set of frequently asked questions to help members understand the review process.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee’s inquiry into the governance of artificial intelligence. The submission likely outlines the organization’s concerns and offers recommendations on how AI should be regulated and overseen.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This policy explains how artificial intelligence is changing the way medical products are regulated and identifies new rules that must be followed. It applies the core principles from the AI White Paper to ensure safety, transparency, and accountability in medical device development and approval.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: This policy outlines the nation's plan to use artificial intelligence in defence, aiming to become the most effective, efficient, trusted, and influential organisation of its size. It focuses on leveraging AI to enhance operational capabilities and maintain a leading edge in security technology.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: The Transport Artificial Intelligence Action Plan explains how the Department for Transport will partner with the transport sector to tap into AI’s benefits while mitigating its risks. It outlines strategies for innovation, safety, data protection, and public trust to ensure AI is used responsibly across the industry.

title: Copyright and artificial intelligence: progress report
description: A progress report on the use of copyright works in the development of AI systems, under Section 137 of the Data (Use and Access) Act.
summary: This report examines how copyright works are currently being used to train AI systems, detailing the legal framework set by Section 137 of the Data (Use and Access) Act. It outlines progress made, challenges faced, and recommendations for balancing creators’ rights with AI innovation.
